title: Poliquin seated preacher curl (B856) - Atlantis
source: Claude's pick (Roman 2026-11-01 walk: preacher curls by the dumbbell benches)

price.kind: estimate: a dealer's list price, not the maker's (Performaxx, Australia, as indexed; the page itself now says request a quote, Atlantis shows 0.00 CAD). About USD 1,850

notes: Why this one: neither Hammer Strength nor Life Fitness makes a preacher bench that works seated AND standing. The Hammer Strength Seated Arm Curl (already in the library) is seated only, the Life Fitness / Signature Arm Curl Bench is standing only with no adjustments. The Atlantis B856 (Pro Series, designed with Charles Poliquin, made in Canada) has an adjustable seat and pad height, a removable seat for standing curls, a two-sided A pad (45 deg one side, near vertical the other), a dumbbell support and bar rests: the closest premium real product. Maker's size 115.1 x 122.7 x 98.7 cm (L x W x H), 95.2 kg. Only one camera angle of it exists online (the maker's render, ref_01, and the same render larger at the dealer, ref_02).
